tg.name: Japetić
tg.description: Japetić is the highest peak of Plešivica, a reserve of forest vegetation with preserved natural beauty. It is a perfect place for hiking, cycling, mountain climbing and nature lovers in general. At the top there is a beautiful view of the region.

tg.name: Vidikovac
tg.description: 360° view of Samobor, the old castle and Zagreb in the distance

tg.name: Podbjelka
tg.note: krov, otvoreno

tg.name: Planinarski dom Žitnica
tg.note: Planinarski dom Žitnica na Japetiću (815 m) ima prostranu blagovaonicu, kuhinju, terasu i 3 sobe sa ukupno 46 ležaja. Opskrbljen je hranom i pićem. Otvoren je petak popodne, subotu, nedjelju, praznicima/blagdanima i prema dogovoru.
